title: Agentic Workspace Operating Decision
description: Derived internal decision composed from admitted AW authority surfaces. It emits exactly one primary action or one typed blocker.

kind.description: Schema discriminator for the composed operating decision.

producer_module.description: Canonical module that produced the operating decision.

producer_function.description: Canonical function that produced the operating decision.

decision_id.description: Stable identity derived from input revisions, action, blocker, and terminal state.

admitted_input_revision.description: Canonical revision of the complete admitted input set from which decision_id is derived.

status.description: Whether the composed decision exposes an action, a blocker, or no immediate action.

input_revisions.description: Revision or freshness identifiers supplied by specialist authority inputs.

canonical_decision_input_revision.description: Canonical revision of the typed action's current owner, context, authority, proof, mutation, evaluation, and executor inputs.

context_authority_coverage.description: Registry-derived coverage of context authority sources and ordinary consumers considered by the decision compiler.

context_authority_projection.description: Consumer-specific admitted context authorities and the typed repair operation when any required source is unavailable.

context_consequences.description: Stable one-per-finding operational consequences, ordered from highest to lowest current impact.

highest_impact_context_consequence.description: The first active or terminal context consequence projected for ordinary consumers, or an empty object.

context_effects.description: Enforced ordinary action, review, claim, closeout, repair, and durable-lifecycle effects compiled from context consequences.

kind.description: Schema discriminator for enforced context effects.

status.description: Whether any active context finding changes ordinary work.

review_gate.description: Owner-review gate and contributing finding identities.

action_narrowing.description: Constraint applied to the current primary action and claims.

blocked_claim_classes.description: Claims forbidden until the owning finding is disposed.

closeout_obligations.description: Finding dispositions required before broad closeout.

typed_repairs.description: Revision-bound repair operations supplied by specialist owners.

durable_dispositions.description: Stable routed or deferred owner destinations and re-entry triggers.

convergence_rule.description: Rule for deduplication, terminal lifecycle, and continuation convergence.

intent_feedback.description: Revision-bound applicable intent expectations, evidence evaluation, material findings, and quiet/rescope posture composed before the final decision.

memory_effectiveness.description: Decision-bound Memory contributions, sparse outcome attribution, material findings, and stronger-owner lifecycle review.

learning_effectiveness.description: Sparse cross-owner later-outcome attribution joined through each destination's existing revision identity and the canonical operating-decision identity; omitted when no later outcome applies.

learning_promotion.description: Evidence-, authority-, latitude-, revision-, and proof-bounded selection of existing stronger-owner operations plus post-promotion subtraction; omitted on quiet paths.

bounded_adaptations.description: Deduplicated currentness or missing-coverage candidates derived from existing improvement evidence and routed to canonical owner operations or explicit decisions.

maintenance_decision.description: At most one compact semantic currentness or coverage decision with source-bound alternatives and canonical owner apply operations.

source_guidance.description: Compact references for admitted source-owned guidance whose registry contract declares a material decision dimension.

future_context_signals.description: Relevant source-owned post-action signals carried to existing consequence and reconciliation owners; empty when no signal applies.

future_context_capture.description: Optional host-owned capability posture; unsupported feedback sources are reported as unavailable rather than claimed captured.

future_learning.description: Ephemeral composition receipt for source-owned outcome evidence assessed into existing future-context and reconciliation custody; never a durable learning-event store.

repo_improvement_action.description: Mode-constrained initiative consequence for one admitted material repo-improvement candidate; empty when no candidate exists. Mutation still requires an existing owner operation.

repo_improvement_execution.description: Existing-owner implementation, Planning promotion, review, or disposition mapping for the admitted repo-improvement action; empty when no candidate exists.

repo_improvement_effectiveness.description: Sparse recurrence, shifted-cost, Evaluation, and retirement result for a completed improvement claim; empty before a claim exists.

instruction_clause_projection.description: Revision-bound explanation of source-owned facts, bounded clauses, composed effects, and target-scoped blockers feeding this compiler.

scoped_instruction_projection.description: Human-facing matched and suppressed scoped Markdown instructions; irrelevant bodies remain unloaded.

reconciliation.description: Generic post-action result, bounded claim, residue, continuation, and constructible next-action composition supplied by domain owners.

control_inputs.description: Applicable host, local-runtime, module, and task-derived inputs reduced to their material effects on the current contract.

assurance.description: Admission of a repository-owned assurance classification, quiet when no external classifier is configured.

repo_evidence_strategy.description: Repository-owned evidence methodology admitted by proof selection and composed into the canonical operating decision.

cross_owner_enforcement.description: Registry-derived join identities, peer-surface dispositions, and fail-closed findings bound to this decision identity.

kind.description: Schema discriminator for the decision-bound enforcement projection.

status.description: Whether registry and peer identities satisfy the cross-owner gate.

decision_id.description: Canonical decision identity carried by this projection.

admitted_input_revision.description: Revision of the complete admitted specialist input set.

canonical_decision_input_revision.description: Live typed-action input revision when an executable action exists.

dimensions.description: Registry-owned source owner and join-identity map.

peer_surface_dispositions.description: Registered authority disposition for ordinary peer surfaces.

observed_peer_projections.description: Optional peers checked against this canonical decision identity.

invariants.description: Release-gating impossibility invariants applied by the projection.

findings.description: Fail-closed identity, authority, or scope violations.

surface_growth_rule.description: Registry ratchet for new decision-shaped surfaces.

rule.description: Authority boundary for specialist facts and peer projections.

current_work.description: Current-work identity admitted into the composed decision.

selected_owner.description: Selected owner identity admitted into the composed decision.

terminal_state.description: Terminal outcome state used for continuation or finalization claims.

primary_action.description: Exactly one typed primary action when status is actionable; empty otherwise.

action_identity.description: Typed operation identity and live input revision used for execution-safety comparison.

external_blocker.description: Exactly one typed blocker when status is blocked; empty otherwise.

blocked_claim_classes.description: Claim classes this decision does not authorize.

provenance.description: Specialist authority inputs and owners preserved for traceability.

replacement_map.description: Compatibility map from older overlapping fields to their derived or demoted source.

additionalProperties.description: Replacement, demotion, or derivation rule for one legacy field.

rule.description: Invariant explaining authority composition and non-inference boundaries.
